description: DataClima is the catalogue of climate data platforms of the Center for Climate and Resilience Research (CR)2 in Chile. The catalogue read on 2026-09-28 filters platforms by type, variables, time range, data type, resolution, source institutions, domain and spatial unit, and lists among others the Climate Explorer with daily weather and streamflow records since 1940 for Chile and South America and data export; VisMet with hourly real-time temperature and precipitation from 2000 compiled from the water directorate, the weather service and other networks; CAMELS-CL with catchment streamflow, gridded precipitation and temperature, land use and topography; a high mountain station at 3,685 metres; explorers for GPM satellite rainfall and ERA5 reanalysis; AURA for urban climate and energy demand modelling; a heatwave precursor monitor; Ciudades Resilientes with historical and future indicators for Chilean cities; and communal greenhouse gas emissions for 2015 to 2022. Coverage is Chile, some platforms South America or global. Access is free; licences are set per platform and were not read. Caveats: it is a directory, so each platform has its own sources and formats. It supports hazard exposure and adaptation studies, such as drought and heat indicators for Chilean water utilities and cities. No related CR2 platform record is catalogued.
